main_argument_chains.claim: A central bank can issue a digital currency that fully replaces cash, the steady state matches the world economy, and adoption spills over to other countries.
support_steps: Extend a four-sector DSGE so the holding share is free
Show full replacement is closest to published ratios
Reduce fourteen indicators to four adoption factors
Confirm digital currency sits in the low laundering class
Shock Tunisia and read the indirect effect
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Issue soon, fully replace cash, and let the first movers pull their neighbours.
